review: The curve is broken. Spike Garden is stage 2 but only 30% pass it, and even the high-skill run stalls below a spiked ledge with no readable route. Saw Mill at 27% is harder than Crumble Bridge at 77%, and Spring Loaded has zero deaths, so springs are never tested. Laser Gate kills two of three players at the first beam after two seconds; I see no safe place to learn the blink timing. First Steps and Crumble Bridge teach well. Gauntlet combines every mechanic, which I like, but 23% with one death cluster before the goal feels punishing. Screens are clear and hazards read well.
best: Crumble Bridge introduces crumbling tiles on safe ground first and lands in the target band with readable deaths.
worst: Spike Garden is a stage-2 wall where even the high-skill player finds no way forward.
